settings.question: Do you service cars from Taylors Lakes?
settings.answer: Yes. Plenty of Taylors Lakes drivers have their cars serviced with us. Taylors Lakes is about a 13 minute drive from Sunshine West. It is an easy run down, and we make drop-off and collection as simple as possible.

settings.question: How often should I service my car?
settings.answer: Most cars need a service every 6 months or 10,000 to 15,000 kilometres, whichever comes first, but it depends on your make, model and how you drive. We follow your manufacturer's log book schedule, so you are servicing at the right intervals for your car.

settings.question: Will a log book service at Niche keep my new car warranty?
settings.answer: Yes. We service to the manufacturer's log book schedule using quality parts and stamp your book, which keeps your new car warranty intact. By law you do not have to return to the dealer to protect it.

settings.question: What is the difference between a log book and a general service?
settings.answer: A log book service follows the exact schedule and checklist your manufacturer sets for that model and kilometres. A general service covers the essentials, oil and filter, fluids, brakes, tyres and a safety check, and is ideal for older cars that are out of warranty.

settings.question: How much does a car service cost?
settings.answer: It depends on your make, model and which service is due. We give you a clear, upfront price when you book, so you know the cost before we start and there are no surprises when you collect the car.

settings.question: How long does a car service take?
settings.answer: A standard log book or general service is usually done the same day. If we find anything that needs extra work, we call you with a price first, so you stay in control of what gets done.

settings.question: Do you service all makes and models?
settings.answer: Yes, petrol and diesel, from everyday runabouts to performance cars. We are Holden and Commodore specialists, but we service everything with the same care and upfront pricing.

settings.question: Which suburbs do you service?
settings.answer: We are based in Sunshine West and look after drivers across Melbourne's west, including Sunshine, St Albans, Deer Park, Keilor, Footscray, Yarraville, Altona, Williamstown and the surrounding suburbs.

settings.question: Do I need to book my service in advance?
settings.answer: Booking ahead helps us get you in at a time that suits and have the right parts ready, but give us a call and we will fit you in as soon as we can.
